docs.summary: Recognises a humanoid rig in a skeleton: bone names are normalized, split into a side and a name, matched against [`GetNameAliases`](#api~Prowl.Motion.HumanTrait~GetNameAliases), then the topology is validated.
Cheap check: does this skeleton resolve to a full, topologically valid humanoid?

members.name: TryMap
members.signature: public static bool TryMap(Skeleton skeleton, out HumanDescription description)

docs.summary: Attempts to build a humanoid mapping for the skeleton. Returns true and a populated [`HumanDescription`](#api~Prowl.Motion.HumanDescription) if the rig is a humanoid; otherwise false (the description still holds any partial mapping found).
Maps the skeleton and returns the full result (mapping, humanoid flag, unmapped frontier).
